encryptionAndServerValidation.description: If set, Datastream will enforce encryption and authenticate server identity.

encryptionNotEnforced.description: If set, Datastream will not enforce encryption. If the DB server mandates encryption, then connection will be encrypted but server identity will not be authenticated.

description: SQLServer table.
name: SqlServerTable

columns.description: SQLServer columns in the schema. When unspecified as part of include/exclude objects, includes/excludes everything.

description: Configuration to use Transaction Logs CDC read method.
name: SqlServerTransactionLogs

description: Srv connection format.
name: SrvConnectionFormat

description: Standard connection format.

directConnection.description: Optional. Deprecated: Use the `additional_options` map to specify the `directConnection` parameter instead. For example: `additional_options = {"directConnection": "true"}`. Specifies whether the client connects directly to the host[:port] in the connection URI.

description: Request for manually initiating a backfill job for a specific stream object.
name: StartBackfillJobRequest

eventFilter.description: Optional. Optional event filter. If not set, or empty, the backfill will be performed on the entire object. This is currently used for partial backfill and only supported for SQL sources.

description: Response for manually initiating a backfill job for a specific stream object.
name: StartBackfillJobResponse

object.description: The stream object resource a backfill job was started for.

description: Static IP address connectivity. Used when the source database is configured to allow incoming connections from the Datastream public IP addresses for the region specified in the connection profile.
name: StaticServiceIpConnectivity

description: The `Status` type defines a logical error model that is suitable for different programming environments, including REST APIs and RPC APIs. It is used by [gRPC](https://github.com/grpc). Each `Status` message contains three pieces of data: error code, error message, and error details. You can find out more about this error model and how to work with it in the [API Design Guide](https://cloud.google.com/apis/design/errors).
name: Status

code.description: The status code, which should be an enum value of google.rpc.Code.

details.description: A list of messages that carry the error details. There is a common set of message types for APIs to use.

message.description: A developer-facing error message, which should be in English. Any user-facing error message should be localized and sent in the google.rpc.Status.details field, or localized by the client.

description: Request for manually stopping a running backfill job for a specific stream object.
name: StopBackfillJobRequest

description: Response for manually stop a backfill job for a specific stream object.
name: StopBackfillJobResponse

object.description: The stream object resource the backfill job was stopped for.

description: A resource representing streaming data from a source to a destination.
name: Stream

backfillAll.description: Automatically backfill objects included in the stream source configuration. Specific objects can be excluded.

backfillNone.description: Do not automatically backfill any objects.

createTime.description: Output only. The creation time of the stream.

customerManagedEncryptionKey.description: Immutable. A reference to a KMS encryption key. If provided, it will be used to encrypt the data. If left blank, data will be encrypted using an internal Stream-specific encryption key provisioned through KMS.

errors.description: Output only. Errors on the Stream.

lastRecoveryTime.description: Output only. If the stream was recovered, the time of the last recovery. Note: This field is currently experimental.

name.description: Output only. Identifier. The stream's name.

ruleSets.description: Optional. Rule sets to apply to the stream.

satisfiesPzi.description: Output only. Reserved for future use.

satisfiesPzs.description: Output only. Reserved for future use.

updateTime.description: Output only. The last update time of the stream.

description: Configuration to stream large object values.
name: StreamLargeObjects

description: A specific stream object (e.g a specific DB table).
name: StreamObject

backfillJob.description: The latest backfill job that was initiated for the stream object.

createTime.description: Output only. The creation time of the object.

customizationRules.description: Output only. The customization rules for the object. These rules are derived from the parent Stream's `rule_sets` and represent the intended configuration for the object.

errors.description: Output only. Active errors on the object.

name.description: Output only. Identifier. The object resource's name.

sourceObject.description: The object identifier in the data source.

updateTime.description: Output only. The last update time of the object.

name: TimeUnitPartition

name: UserCredentials

password.description: Optional. Password for the Salesforce connection. Mutually exclusive with the `secret_manager_stored_password` field.

secretManagerStoredPassword.description: Optional. A reference to a Secret Manager resource name storing the Salesforce connection's password. Mutually exclusive with the `password` field.

secretManagerStoredSecurityToken.description: Optional. A reference to a Secret Manager resource name storing the Salesforce connection's security token. Mutually exclusive with the `security_token` field.

securityToken.description: Optional. Security token for the Salesforce connection. Mutually exclusive with the `secret_manager_stored_security_token` field.

username.description: Required. Username for the Salesforce connection.

description: User-password credentials.
name: UserPasswordCredentials

description: The VPC Peering configuration is used to create VPC peering between Datastream and the consumer's VPC.
name: VpcPeeringConfig

subnet.description: Required. A free subnet for peering. (CIDR of /29)

vpc.description: Required. Fully qualified name of the VPC that Datastream will peer to. Format: `projects/{project}/global/{networks}/{name}`

description: Profile for connecting to a Workday source.
name: WorkdayProfile

host.description: Required. Host for the Workday connection. Must be a valid hostname (e.g., `wd3-impl-services1.workday.com`).

oauthRefreshTokenCredentials.description: Required. Credentials for authenticating with the Workday API. OAuth Refresh Token credentials for authenticating with the Workday API.

tenant.description: Required. Tenant for the Workday connection (e.g., `google12`).

description: Configuration for syncing data from a Workday source.
name: WorkdaySourceConfig

excludeObjects.description: Optional. The objects to exclude from the stream.

includeObjects.description: Optional. The objects to retrieve from the source.

pollingInterval.description: Required. Incremental sync polling interval for all objects. If not set, a default value of `5 minutes` is used. The duration must be from `5 minutes` to `24 hours`, inclusive.
